scientific_integrity: The model and local stability were published previously. The new statement is the sharp full-plane sign regime with complete trajectories and global convergence. Independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Planar star-shaped polygons; strict crossing convention; excludes origin and Filippov sliding; full predecessor text unavailable. No claim outside angular-positivity regime or for arbitrary perturbations.
title: Sharp global angular positivity and punctured-plane attraction in polygonal affine oscillators
